description.value:
The magic of your Vestige Companion ensures you always have certain spells ready. Choose one of the following Cleric domains: Life, Light, Trickery, or War. The Domain Spells of your chosen domain are Warlock spells for you. When you reach a Warlock level equal to a Cleric level listed in the Domain Spells table of that domain, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared. For example, with the War Domain, at Warlock level 3 you have the Guiding Bolt, Magic Weapon, Shield of Faith, and Spiritual Weapon spells prepared.
